findings.description: Dry-run can execute arbitrary shell commands. run() calls env_parts() before checking dry_run; env_parts() executes every declared Round-identity command through subprocess.run(shell=True). A root spec containing a mutating identity command therefore causes side effects during --amendment NN --dry-run, despite printing that nothing was executed.
findings.evidence: Source inspection only. The dry-run fixture has no Round-identity declaration, and its execution counter wraps status._run_row rather than the subprocess calls used for identity probes.
findings.recommendation: Avoid executing identity probes during dry-run; report unavailable identity conservatively. Cover this boundary by observing subprocess invocation and filesystem changes.

findings.description: The declared dependency closure permits external-state results to be reused without an offline contract or verified state identity. prove() checks file fingerprints and optional environment identity but does not require hermetic reuse. Docker identity consists only of container ID and start time. Database contents can change while those values remain constant, allowing an old database PASS to be reused. cmd_verify() accepts the amendment reuse entry directly.
findings.evidence: Source inspection only; no database checks were executed. This existing dependency behavior contradicts the documented requirement that container identity alone must not establish database freshness.
findings.recommendation: Require an explicit validated offline contract for reuse, or execute external-state rows again unless their relevant state is independently established.

findings.description: The supplied execution evidence does not establish coverage and input identity for the complete listed test dependency closure. Neither round test file appears in the receipt input hashes or execution command, although the amendment tests depend on their fixture implementations.
findings.evidence: The supplied log reports 123 passed and 23 subtests passed. Current hashes match the receipt for the amendment implementation, mirror, four runtime dependencies and two amendment test files. The two round test files have no receipt entries. No tests were run during this review.
findings.recommendation: Provide existing execution evidence that fingerprints these transitive test inputs and establishes the relevant round-contract coverage.
